jobs.occupation: Senior Project Manager, Strategic Procurement Initiatives
jobs.description:
Job Description: Are you passionate about project management, and think strategy execution in a Nordic role sounds exciting? Are you motivated by driving complex initiatives across functions and countries, turning strategic ambitions into tangible business results?

If so, you could be our new Senior Project Manager in Project Management & Strategy Execution, Group Procurement.

At Tryg, Procurement plays a central role in shaping and developing our Nordic partner and supplier ecosystem. Through strategic sourcing initiatives, partnerships, and transformation projects, we help create business value, improve customer experiences, and support the delivery of Tryg’s strategic priorities across the Nordics.

About the role | Turning strategy into results

As a Project Manager, you will play a key role in executing Procurement’s strategic agenda. Through strategic sourcing projects and transformation initiatives, you will help translate ambitions into tangible results that strengthen our business, improve customer outcomes, and create measurable value across Tryg.

You will take on a Nordic role with responsibility for driving projects from initial analysis and scoping through implementation and benefit realization. Many of the projects span countries, business areas, and stakeholder groups, with Claims being one of our key partners.

Working closely with leaders, specialists, and key stakeholders across the organization, you will be responsible for creating alignment, driving progress, and ensuring successful execution across diverse perspectives, priorities, and dependencies.

Projects vary in scope and focus and may include:

• Strategic partnerships and supplier development

• Process optimization and operational excellence

• Digitalization and automation initiatives

• Cost and value creation programs

• Customer and partner experience improvements

Common to all projects is their focus on turning strategic priorities into meaningful change in how we work with partners and how customers experience Tryg.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Leading strategic projects and transformation initiatives from analysis and planning through implementation and benefit realization.

• Establishing clear project goals, plans, governance structures, and success criteria.

• Ensuring progress, quality, risk management, and dependency tracking throughout project lifecycles.

• Creating alignment and engagement among stakeholders across Procurement and the wider organization.

• Challenging existing ways of working and transforming opportunities into concrete improvements.

• Driving implementation and ensuring sustainable organizational adoption of new solutions and processes.

• Contributing to the continued development of our project management methodologies, tools, and ways of working.

We are looking for project managers with different profiles and levels of experience.

Depending on your experience and background, you will take responsibility for projects of varying size and complexity. As a Senior Project Manager, you will lead larger cross-functional initiatives and programs while also contributing to the further development of our project management capabilities.

For one of the positions, we are particularly interested in candidates with experience from the automotive industry, as several upcoming initiatives will focus on developing our workshop partnerships, spare parts ecosystem, and other key areas of the automotive value chain.

About you | Analytical, proactive, and collaborative

You are motivated by creating results through collaboration and thrive at the intersection of business, strategy, and execution. You are able to create structure in complex situations, challenge existing approaches, and turn ideas and analyses into practical solutions.

You likely hold a relevant university degree and have experience within project management, transformation, or strategic development, either from a similar role or from management consulting.

We place particular emphasis on candidates who:

• Have a proven track record of leading complex projects or transformation initiatives from analysis to implementation.

• Possess strong analytical capabilities and can translate complex challenges into clear recommendations and decision-making material.

• Work in a structured manner and take ownership of progress, quality, and outcomes.

• Have strong stakeholder management skills and can create commitment across functions, teams, and organizational levels.

• Are curious, challenge the status quo constructively, and actively seek opportunities for improvement.

Experience within Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Supplier Management, or the insurance industry is considered an advantage. However, what matters most is your ability to lead complex initiatives, understand business priorities, and create measurable results.

About us | Project Management & Strategy Execution

You will join the Project Management & Strategy Execution team within Group Procurement.

Our mission is to ensure successful execution of Procurement’s strategic priorities in close collaboration with our sister team, Strategy & Innovation Hub. While Strategy & Innovation Hub focuses on opportunity identification, analysis, business cases, and benefit definition, our team is responsible for driving execution, implementation, and organizational anchoring.

Together, we ensure that strategy becomes reality.

We bring an analytical, structured, and results-oriented approach to our work, while believing that outstanding results and a healthy work environment go hand in hand. We therefore prioritize an environment characterized by high ambitions, strong collaboration, and continuous professional and personal development.

With us, you will gain:

• A highly visible Nordic role with broad stakeholder exposure.

• The opportunity to work on strategically important projects with meaningful business impact.

• Close collaboration with leaders, specialists, and decision-makers across Tryg.

• The chance to influence both the projects you lead and the future development of project management within Procurement.

We value trust, accountability, and teamwork, and we believe the best results are created together.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Please submit your application and CV no later than 22nd of November.

We encourage applicants not to include a photo in their CV.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and invite selected candidates for interviews continuously, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The recruitment process will close once the right candidate has been identified.

If you have any questions regarding the position, please feel free to contact Jonas Klestrup, Head of Project Management & Strategy Execution, at jonas.klestrup@tryg.dk.

We encourage everyone regardless of gender identity, age, background, disability or origin to apply for the position. We are proud to have high employee satisfaction, strong professionalism and equal opportunities to develop your career in the Tryg Group. Tryg is the largest non-life insurance company in Scandinavia with activities in Denmark, Norway and Sweden. Every day we strive – each in our own way – to create peace of mind and affect the lives of most Scandinavians. Read more at www.tryg.com

Spirii has spent the past seven years building the infrastructure behind EV charging in Europe. Today, we operate across multiple markets and support CPOs, fleets, workplaces, and public charging networks with software and hardware solutions that make EV charging simpler to manage and scale. We are headquartered in Copenhagen and part of the Edenred group.

We are now at an important stage of growth. The market is moving fast, our product is maturing, and our organisation is scaling. That brings new opportunities, new complexity, and a need for even stronger alignment and execution across the company.

**The role

**As Director of Strategy & Execution, you will be the operational centre of gravity for the Spirii leadership team. This is a high-impact role for someone who can hold strategic context, drive cross-functional execution, and step into whatever the moment requires.

In practice, that means moving between the strategic and the operational with ease. One week you may be preparing a board presentation or supporting a key business decision. The next, you are driving alignment across product and commercial, or bringing structure to an initiative that spans multiple teams. The role requires both breadth and depth — and the judgement to know which is needed.

**What You Will Do

****Strategic execution

**

• Work directly with the CEO and leadership team on the company’s most important priorities, translating direction into plans, and plans into measurable outcomes

• Drive the quarterly planning cycle, OKRs, and cross-functional initiatives from kickoff through to follow-through

• Support leadership decision-making by structuring information, surfacing trade-offs, and ensuring the right inputs are in place

**Leadership alignment

**

• Own the operating rhythm of the leadership team — weekly syncs, planning sessions, offsites, and follow-up

• Identify where alignment is breaking down across commercial, product, engineering, and operations — and address it proactively

• Serve as a trusted connector across the organisation, helping teams stay coordinated and focused on shared priorities

**Special projects

**

• Lead high-impact projects that do not naturally sit within one department, and work with Edenred stakeholders on shared initiatives and reporting when needed

• Take complex, ambiguous problems, define them clearly, and drive them through to resolution

**Communication

**

• Support the CEO in communicating clearly across the organisation — all-hands updates, leadership messaging, and internal communications during periods of change

• Prepare board materials, investor presentations, and executive reviews

**What We’re Looking For

**

• 4–8 years of experience in a corporate development, management consulting, strategy, or general management role — ideally with exposure to B2B software

• Comfortable operating in ambiguity: you build the structure rather than waiting for it

• Strong written communication — you can turn a messy situation into a one-pager

• Commercially literate enough to sit in a room with customers or partners and follow the conversation

• Fluency in English required; Danish and/or German a plus given our footprint

• Discretion. You’ll see confidential commercial, board, and people matters — trust has to be earned fast and kept

• Genuine curiosity about EV charging, energy, or infrastructure software is a plus, not a requirement — but you’ll need to get fluent in OCPP, ISO 15118, and how CPMS/eMSP actually make money, quickly

**Benefits

**It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work-life balance.

• Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.

• Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.

• Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.

• Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.

• Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.

• Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.

• Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but fluent English language skills are required.

**About Spirii – Who We Are

**Spirii is a full-service e-mobility provider which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. Spirii was founded seven years ago as a company. Nevertheless, the people in Spirii have extensive experience working with electric cars and charging, as well as the development of future transport- and energy systems.

Spirii is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. Spirii strives to create an inclusive and diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of age, gender, race, sexual/religious orientation, or disability.

**The Impact You'll Make

**At Danfoss Climate Solutions, we are driving the transition toward more sustainable and energy-efficient solutions. As our Global Inventory Manager (m/f/d), you will ensure the right products are available at the right time across our global network, balancing customer service, working capital, and operational efficiency.

Working within a global supply chain organization, you will take ownership of inventory strategy and performance across regions and sites. Through data-driven decision-making, process standardization, and cross-functional collaboration, you will help optimize inventory, support business growth, and strengthen supply chain performance.

As part of a business experiencing significant global expansion, you will have the opportunity to shape best practices, drive continuous improvement, and make a visible impact on our customers and our business.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Own and drive the global inventory strategy, performance management, and inventory optimization agenda across regions and sites.

• Monitor inventory performance, identify improvement opportunities, and implement actions that balance service levels, inventory investment, and cost.

• Standardize inventory processes, develop data-driven reporting, and lead cross-functional initiatives that strengthen global supply chain performance.

• Develop and enhance reporting tools and dashboards (Excel, Power BI) to support data-driven decision-making and inventory optimization.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Experience in inventory management within a multinational, multi-site manufacturing or supply chain environment.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, influence stakeholders, and drive results in a global matrix organization.

• Strong analytical and business acumen, including the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights using tools such as Excel and Power BI.

• Experience working with S&OP/SIOP planning processes; knowledge of Integrated Business Planning (IBP) is an advantage.

• A proactive, structured, and self-driven approach with the ability to thrive in a fast-growing and evolving global environment.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

**Your impact begins here

**As Safety Surveillance Principal Specialist, you will be the safety lead for several products in Novo’s early pipeline, working where non-clinical and clinical development meet. You will turn emerging data into a clear early safety profile and shape decisions for first-in-human and early clinical studies. Your scientific judgement will help protect the people taking part in these studies and give development teams the clarity to move at pace.

**What You’ll Bring

**You are a scientist first. You are confident, outgoing and driven, and you want to be in the room where early safety decisions are made.

• A PhD, MD, DVM, MSc Pharm or equivalent in Medicine or Natural Sciences, with extensive experience in pharmacovigilance or early-phase pharmaceutical development.

• A solid understanding of drug development processes, global regulatory requirements and GxP standards.

• A strong grasp of medical concepts, disease mechanisms and scientific methodology. You use data to build scientific understanding, rather than letting the data lead you.

• The ability to identify challenges, shape strategies and turn them into clear, actionable steps.

• Confidence to take informed scientific risks and make a call, while never compromising on patient safety.

• Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to guide and influence others through mentorship and informal leadership.

• A self-driven, ethical and adaptable approach. You work independently, address issues proactively and stay flexible when priorities change.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Own the early safety profile of products, evaluating emerging pre-clinical and clinical safety data to guide patient surveillance and business decisions.

• Lead the resolution of complex safety challenges and provide strong scientific and medical input across development activities.

• Shape study designs, clinical protocols and benefit-risk assessments, working to ambitious development timelines.

• Chair a cross-functional drug safety committee and represent Safety Surveillance in key cross-functional teams.

• Drive initiatives that strengthen scientific, strategic and operational excellence within Safety Surveillance.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join Safety Surveillance Early Development, part of Global Patient Safety in Research & Development. It is a team of 8 colleagues in Denmark, and it handles all First Human Dose (FHD) studies across all indications at Novo. The team provides scientific safety expertise to early-stage projects, contributes to safety strategy and supports protocol review, risk assessments, early signal detection and cross-functional safety forums.

Your closest partners will be the non-clinical project manager, the medical specialist and the clinical pharmacologist. Together you will design studies that are scientifically strong and move quickly. You will also work with skilled colleagues across Non-clinical and Clinical Development, and across several therapeutic areas.

The environment is dynamic, collaborative and highly engaged. Colleagues share scientific insights, speak openly and support one another when evaluating complex safety data. Everyone is focused on doing what is best for the people we serve.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will have real ownership. As safety lead, you will be trusted to work independently, make your voice heard and influence decisions that guide early development. You will keep learning from colleagues across Non-clinical and Clinical Development, and you will help strengthen a culture of knowledge sharing and openness in the team.

You’re curious about how collaboration services can evolve, including through responsible use of automation and AI.

Does this sound like you? If so, we’d like to hear from you.

In this role, you’ll have the scope to shape a broad, business-critical portfolio and help make everyday collaboration more secure, reliable and effective for employees.

The Data Platform IT team at Danske Bank is looking for a Cloud Platform Engineer to design, build, and continuously improve the Databricks platform that underpins data capabilities across the organization. Your work will shape the reliability and scalability of a platform used by engineers, architects, and data practitioners every day. In return, you will grow your skills in a collaborative environment with real technical depth.

What you will be doing

You will join a team of engineers and architects working on a platform that matters. The Data Platform IT squad operates with a high degree of technical ownership, and you will work closely with platform users, architects, and fellow engineers to translate real needs into self-service capabilities. The team values pragmatic thinking, open collaboration, and continuous improvement, and you will contribute to shaping how the platform evolves across environments.

In your day-to-day work, you will:

• 
Design and build scalable capabilities on the Databricks platform across environments

• 
Develop automation using Infrastructure as Code, primarily Terraform

• 
Improve CI/CD and release automation using GitHub Enterprise Cloud and related tooling

• 
Build observability, monitoring, alerting, and automated remediation across the platform

• 
Implement security, identity and access management, and data governance capabilities

• 
Troubleshoot complex platform issues and contribute to stable production operations

• 
Collaborate with engineers, architects, and platform users to deliver self-service solutions

About you

• 
Solid experience in cloud platform engineering, preferably on AWS

• 
Experience with Databricks or a comparable enterprise data platform

• 
Skilled with Infrastructure as Code tools, preferably Terraform

• 
Familiarity with CI/CD, version control, and software engineering practices including GitHub or Azure DevOps

• 
Experience with identity and access management, platform security, and governance controls

• 
Understanding of monitoring, logging, observability, and production platform operations at scale

• 
Clear communicator who collaborates across disciplines and takes pragmatic technical ownership

If you have experience in adjacent areas of cloud or data platform engineering, we welcome your application even if your background does not match every point above.

What we offer you

You will be part of a team where your technical contributions make a tangible difference to the data capabilities of a major financial institution. We support hybrid working, with three to four days per week in the office to encourage collaboration and knowledge sharing. You will have access to learning opportunities and the chance to develop your expertise alongside skilled colleagues.

Are you ready for the next step?

If this role sounds like the right fit for you, please get in touch with hiring manager Vladimiras Cincikas at vlci@danskebank.lt with any questions, or apply directly through our careers page.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible or by the 27th of November, 2026 at the latest.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**Job Description

**Shape the engineering solutions behind vaccines that protect lives every day

**Are you an experienced bioprocess engineer who combines deep technical expertise with the ability to set direction and bring people together?

Join Bavarian Nordic and take a leading role in shaping the processes and systems that support our Drug Substance manufacturing.

From major capital projects and technology transfers to solving complex manufacturing challenges, you will help ensure our processes are robust, scalable, and ready for reliable operation.

**Your impact

**As Senior Engineering Specialist, you will serve as a technical authority for integrated bioprocess systems across process engineering, automation, filtration, and equipment design.

You will guide critical technical decisions throughout the manufacturing lifecycle—from concept and scale-up through qualification, validation, and continuous improvement.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with broad technical responsibility and influence across functions and projects. You will lead technical workstreams and mentor experienced engineers without formal line-management responsibility.

**What You Will Do

**Working closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Automation, Quality, Validation, and external partners, you will:

• Lead bioprocess design and optimization: Set the technical direction for upstream and downstream processes, purification, bulk formulation, and sterile transfers. Use process knowledge, modelling, and manufacturing data to improve yield, capacity, reliability, and product quality.

• Shape automation and control strategies: Translate process needs into requirements for PLC/DCS and SCADA systems, recipes, sequences, interlocks, and alarms. Ensure solutions support effective process control, data integrity, and reliable operation.

• Provide technical leadership for filtration: Define filter selection, sizing, validation, and integrity-testing strategies for liquid and gas systems. Lead investigations into filter failures, pressure deviations, and performance issues.

• Guide equipment and system design: Review and approve tanks, piping, pumps, valves, and instrumentation, including hydraulic calculations, pressure distribution, and pressure-testing strategies. Lead technical decisions for Cleaning-in-Place and Sterilization-in-Place (CIP/SIP) systems.

• Deliver projects and technology transfers: Lead process engineering activities from concept and vendor selection through factory and site acceptance testing, commissioning, qualification, process validation, and handover to operations.

• Strengthen technical standards and compliance: Resolve complex investigations, support change controls and CAPAs, and represent engineering during audits and inspections. Establish reusable design standards and share knowledge across projects and teams.

**What You Bring

**You have a master’s degree or PhD in Bioengineering, Biochemical or Chemical Engineering, Biotechnology, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related discipline.

You bring substantial industrial experience, typically 15 years or more, including at least 10 years within pharmaceutical, biotechnology or vaccine manufacturing.

Your experience includes:

• Leading complex engineering projects as a lead engineer or technical authority, with hands-on expertise in bioprocess development, scale-up, commercial manufacturing, and lifecycle management.

• Integrating process equipment with automation and SCADA systems, including control strategies, computerized-system validation, and data integrity.

• Designing and validating filtration systems, including filter integrity testing and pressure/flow troubleshooting.

• Working with hygienic tanks and piping, hydraulic calculations, pressure testing, CIP/SIP, and contamination control.

• Leading commissioning, qualification, process validation, Process Performance Qualification, and technology transfer, supported by a strong understanding of GMP and quality risk management.

• Setting technical standards, mentoring experienced engineers, and influencing decisions across functions without relying on formal authority.

**How You Work

**You combine scientific depth with practical engineering judgement. You can move from detailed technical analysis to clear recommendations that help colleagues and leaders make informed decisions.

You take ownership, challenge assumptions constructively, and remain focused when problems span multiple systems or disciplines. Whether working with operators, specialists, suppliers, or senior stakeholders, you communicate clearly and build trust through sound decisions and consistent follow-through.

You also enjoy developing others. Sharing expertise, coaching colleagues, and creating common standards are natural parts of how you work.

**Why join Bavarian Nordic?

**At Bavarian Nordic, we work to protect lives through vaccines. In this role, you will help build and improve the manufacturing capabilities that make that purpose possible.

You will have the opportunity to influence major technical decisions, strengthen engineering practices, and see your work translate into measurable improvements in manufacturing performance and reliable supply.

Our values—Persisting Pioneers, Embracing Change, and Boosted by the Team—shape how we collaborate and solve challenges. For the right candidate, sustained performance may open opportunities for broader engineering leadership or formal people management.

**Ready to shape the future of our Drug Substance manufacturing?

**We look forward to receiving your application and learning how your technical expertise and leadership could strengthen Bavarian Nordic.

As a Diagnostic and Scientific Liaison, you will be the in-country scientific expert who turns strategy into practical testing solutions that directly impact patient identification and care in your assigned Nordic country. the testing landscape so clinicians have the evidence they need when it matters most?

_Our AstraZeneca Nordic Marketing Company employs around 550 people and has offices located in Copenhagen, Stockholm, Oslo, and Espoo. AstraZeneca Nordic is a recognized leader in its core therapy areas and aims to improve the lives of millions of people. This is an area where you are free to be more – you are encouraged to challenge traditional ways and test your curiosity. We drive innovative science, deliver key launches, build close collaboration and partnerships within health care.

You will build trusted partnerships with laboratory leaders, pathologists, molecular specialists, and oncologists, bringing scientific clarity and technical guidance to every interaction. Working cross-functionally, you will translate Nordic and global diagnostic direction into focused country plans, remove barriers to timely testing, and help ensure robust, reliable diagnostics are available across the patient journey.

**Accountabilities

**

• Shape Diagnostic Strategy: Assess the country’s diagnostic landscape, patient pathways and laboratory capacity, translating insights into practical testing plans aligned with Nordic and global priorities.

• Build Scientific Partnerships: Engage laboratory leaders and scientific experts related to the brands and their diagnostic challenge through trusted relationships, education and tailored technical communication.

• Drive Brand science in context to the diagnostic strategy. Work holistically with the scientific experts ensuring they buy fully in to the science behind the in line or future brands and the need for diagnosing the right target segment.

• Improve Testing Quality and Access: Identify barriers and bottlenecks, champion quality and appropriate testing, and co-create compliant solutions that improve timeliness and equity.

• Generate Insights and Evidence: Provide diagnostic intelligence to support launches, tactical planning, validation, real-world evidence, and research initiatives.

• Lead Cross-Functional Projects: Drive priorities from planning to delivery, collaborating across country, Nordic and global teams to improve consistency, quality and efficiency.

• Uphold Governance and Compliance: Ensure all activities meet the highest scientific, ethical, privacy, safety, quality and compliance standards, escalating risks appropriately.

**Essential Skills/Experience

**

• Relevant Background: Degree in life sciences, biomedical science, medicine, pharmacy or a related field, with approximately 3–5 years’ experience in diagnostics, biomarker testing, clinical laboratories or healthcare.

• Diagnostic Expertise: Working knowledge of diagnostic pathways, laboratory operations and testing methodologies, with confidence interpreting scientific and technical data.

• Communication and Influence: Ability to explain complex science clearly, deliver compelling technical presentations, and build trusted external relationships.

• Project Delivery: Strong planning, prioritisation and stakeholder-management skills, with a track record of delivering projects in matrix organisations.

• Language and Mobility: Fluency in English and the relevant local Nordic language, with willingness to travel regularly in-country and across the Nordics as needed.

• Valid driver’s license as this is a field-based role.

**Desirable Skills And Experience

**

• Advanced Expertise: Advanced degree or experience in oncology diagnostics, companion diagnostics or biomarker testing, including IHC, NGS or PCR.

• Industry Experience: Background in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, diagnostics or clinical laboratory environments.

• Quality and Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of local diagnostic regulations and quality-assurance requirements.

• Stakeholder and Launch Experience: Experience partnering with laboratories, healthcare professionals and diagnostic providers, and supporting launches, testing implementation, validation, research or real-world evidence initiatives.

• Nordic Collaboration: Experience contributing to cross-country or Nordic projects.

**Inclusion & Diversity

**We are proud to have a unique workplace culture that inspires innovation and collaboration! Here, employees are empowered to express diverse perspectives - and are made to feel valued, energized and rewarded for their ideas and creativity.

**Why AstraZeneca

**Join a team where science leads decisions, and collaboration turns evidence into real change for people living with cancer. Here, unexpected teams gather around the same table to unleash bold thinking, fusing medical expertise with strategic execution to change clinical practice. You will work at the forefront of diagnostics, partnering with external experts and cross-functional colleagues to shape every point in the patient journey. We back ambition with support, value kindness alongside high standards, and create space to test new ideas, learn quickly and scale what works—so your contribution reaches patients, not just slide decks.

**So, what is next?

**Step into this pivotal role to elevate precision diagnostics in your country and help transform cancer care - bring your scientific credibility and project leadership to where they’ll make the biggest impact today.

Welcome with your application, in English, latest **by the 15th of November 2026!

**_Applications will be reviewed continuously throughout the application period.

AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

About Apylon and the opportunity

Apylon is building agents for the most complex workflow out there - financial admin in healthcare.

Hospitals and payers move billions of euros through fragmented, manual workflows shaped by clinical data, payer rules, contracts, and local coding systems. We believe this is a data, machine-learning, and automation problem disguised as financial operations.

We are live with leading private hospitals and expanding quickly. Every hospital presents a different challenge: EHR systems are configured differently, national coding rules vary, and contracts describe the same clinical event in different terms. Your job is to help us turn that complexity into a system that learns: each new integration should make the next one faster, safer, and less expensive.

Apylon is backed by experienced operators and top-tier investors in healthcare and fintech. Our team draws on experience from Zendesk, Pleo, Wawa Fertility, Sibill, and some of the largest multi-country hospital groups in Europe. You’ll join the first small engineering team, with massive ownership over both what we build and how we build it.

Delivering healthcare is hard. Getting paid for it shouldn’t be.

You’ll be responsible for

• Own EHR integrations end to end: APIs, schemas, undocumented behaviour, operational failure modes, and vendor changes.

• Build reusable integration-platform primitives for extraction, normalisation, versioning, replay, monitoring, and observability.

• Design the canonical data model that connects heterogeneous EHR data, reimbursement systems, national coding standards, and hospital-specific conventions.

• Build reliable inputs for our billing agents, including the constraints, validation, and evaluation systems that make model-assisted decisions safe to use in production.

• Work directly with hospital IT teams and EHR vendors: technical discovery, implementation, joint debugging, and onboarding.

• Take responsibility for the full lifecycle of your work: design, deployment, monitoring, incident response, and iteration from real-world data.

Who you are

• 3+ years building and operating production systems in complex, messy domains. We care more about demonstrated judgment and ownership than an exact number of years.

• Experience using LLMs as production components—not just developer tools. You understand when to use models, when deterministic systems are better, how to constrain outputs, and how to evaluate reliability.

• Strong data-modelling instincts. You know when abstraction creates leverage and when it hides important real-world variation.

• Comfort working from incomplete information. You form hypotheses, test them against data, and distinguish unknowns that can wait from assumptions that could invalidate the system.

• Confidence in customer-facing technical work: discovery calls, debugging sessions, and direct conversations with vendors and hospital IT teams.

• Experience with cloud infrastructure and distributed systems.

• A practical, hands-on approach: equally comfortable designing an integration architecture and writing a quick script to answer an urgent question.

This role may be a strong fit if

You enjoy reverse-engineering systems you do not control, finding structure in messy real-world data, and turning one-off discoveries into reusable software. You are comfortable being the engineer in the room with customers and partners.

What this role is not

• Consulting or bespoke delivery work. Each integration must improve the product and reduce the marginal cost of the next.

• A role insulated from customers or operational reality.

• Pure platform engineering or pure integration work: the value comes from doing both.

• A role where incorrect mappings are merely technical defects. In this domain, they can produce incorrect invoices.

Bonus points

• Experience with healthcare interoperability or coding standards, including HL7v2, FHIR, or national messaging and reimbursement standards.

• Experience building and operating third-party integrations at scale.

• Experience in healthcare, fintech, or another regulated environment.

• Experience in an early-stage or fast-growing company.

• Working proficiency in Danish, or German.

Our tech stack

• Python · Django · React · PostgreSQL · AWS · K8s · Terraform · Bedrock

• We’re pragmatic. You’ll have a big say in how it evolves.

What Apylon offers

• The chance to solve one of Europe’s biggest healthcare inefficiencies.

• Competitive salary + stock options (you’ll own part of what you build).

• 25 days of annual leave + local public holidays.

• Lunch on us during workdays at the office.

• Regular off-sites and social events. We like building together, not just working together.

• Travel within the EU roughly monthly. Onboarding a hospital, working through an integration with a vendor’s engineers, or spending time on-site to understand how the data is actually produced. If travelling to a hospital basement to figure out why an export is malformed sounds like a bad week, this isn’t your role.

Working at Apylon means embarking on a highly ambitious mission to rebuild the financial infrastructure of European healthcare. We’re already live with leading private hospitals, processing thousands of invoices, proving that complex payer rules can be turned into code, powering transparent, automated, and intelligent revenue systems.

jobs.occupation: Manager - Business Advisory and Project Management
jobs.description:
Drive meaningful impact across the life sciences industry.

As our next Manager - Business Advisory and Project Management, you will contribute to solving meaningful challenges across the life sciences industry. We offer specialised management consulting services, working with top-tier life sciences companies as well as biotech startups -locally and globally. From strategy development to hands-on implementation, we support our clients were impact matters most.

About the role

As a Manager - Business Advisory and Project Management, you will work closely with clients and colleagues to address complex challenges across the life sciences value chain. You will take ownership of your work and contribute to delivering solutions that create real, lasting impact. This is a Senior role designed to provide project and program leadership to deliver strategic technical solutions that address complex client issues in the Life Sciences industry. You will be handling implementation/migration projects and programs to achieve desired outcomes and ensure successful business growth. You will also seek new business opportunities to help BASE life science grow its presence within existing and new customers.

Additionally, you will contribute to internal initiatives and training to further strengthen BASE life science’s project and program management methodologies, approach, and tools.

You will lead teams consisting of multiple workstreams, which could include BASE/Infosys, external third party, or client stakeholders. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in, project/program management and the ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications.

Your responsibilities include:

• Developing responses to Requests for Proposals (RfPs), ensuring adequate planning for scope, timelines and budget

• Monitoring project/program status including milestones, risks, issues, budgets, etc.

• Acting as a delivery escalation point and proactively ensuring escalations are handled promptly with a clear action and communication plan.

• Creating and delivering tailored communication based on audience, i.e., executive level summaries for client stakeholders, or senior executives in BASE life science, status reports at a project or program-level at a suitable cadence for team members

• Intervening, when necessary, to ensure costs, timelines and quality are on track.

• Lead a cross-functional team to deliver projects/programs to the required scope, on time, within budget, and to the satisfaction of our life science industry stakeholders.

• Collaborate with business stakeholders in the life science industry to understand their needs and translate them into executable plans for the project team.

• Develop plans, timelines, and budgets for projects/programs for which you are responsible.

• Track and report on project/program progress, identifying and mitigating risks as needed.

• Facilitate communication and collaboration between the project team, life science industry stakeholders, and other teams within BASE life science.

You bring:

• 5+ years of experience as a technical project/program manager within Regulatory, Clinical, Quality or other GxP areas in the life science industry.

• Successful track record of managing technically complex projects/programs such as software development, implementation of IT systems, data migrations, etc.

• Experience leading technical teams and delivering data driven projects/programs.

• Experience with project management tools such as JIRA, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project etc.

• Experience with Agile project management methodologies such as SAFe.

• Strong communication skills, both in writing, meetings and in presentations.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

Additionally, the ideal candidate has the following skills/certifications:

• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification

• Experience selling either projects or products to clients.

• Experience working with Veeva Vault, SalesForce or similar technologies.

• Experience working with AI professionally

This position is offered in Denmark and Spain.

Who is BASE life science?

Founded in 2015, BASE life science is a business and technology consulting company working exclusively in life sciences, built on a simple purpose: grow our people, and deliver real impact for our customers.

We don't think AI is a feature you bolt onto existing systems — we think it's the layer through which a life sciences company's strategy actually gets executed, end to end. Most of the industry is still proving AI can do one task at a time, function by function, pilot by pilot. We're building toward something bigger: AI that runs across clinical, regulatory, quality, and commercial work instead of stopping at the edges of a single application.

With headquarters in Denmark and offices across Spain, Switzerland, the UK, Germany, France, Italy, and the US, we work with top-10 pharma and ambitious biotechs alike, and with technology partners including Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA, Google, AWS, Microsoft, and Amass — turning that belief into deployed, compliant, sellable solutions, not slideware.

Why join BASE Life Science?

At BASE, you work on meaningful, complex challenges at the intersection of technology, science, and business. We trust our people with real responsibility and support them in turning ambition into impact — grounded in five core values: team spirit, trust, openness, ambition, and execution.

• Ambition, encouraged through ownership and continuous learning.

• Execution — we focus on delivering solutions that work in practice.

• Openness — your ideas are heard, challenged constructively, and supported as you grow.

• Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance.

• The opportunity to shape a practice, not just staff one.

Alongside this, we offer:

• Support for health and wellbeing, covering physical, mental, and social needs

• Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance

• Ongoing learning and professional development throughout your career

• A modern work setup, with the tools and equipment needed to do great work

• Recognition of performance and impact, linked to contribution and results

• The opportunity to work on challenges that make a meaningful difference for patients and healthcare systems worldwide

Explore our work, values, and people at www.baselifescience.com

Interested?

If you find this position intriguing, don't delay—submit your application in English at your earliest convenience. We are continuously reviewing and assessing all incoming candidates and eagerly await your application.

At BASE Life Science, we value diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Employment decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting, and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials.
